resources.string: Only runs while Instagram or YouTube is open. It reads tab names so it can leave Reels, Search, and Shorts. It does not read messages, passwords, or banking apps, and it has no internet access.
Could not prepare the install file.
Instagram is not installed on this phone.

What this app does

You keep the normal Instagram app.

Stays open
• Home
• Messages
• Stories
• A reel a friend sent inside a chat

Search sends you to your messages.

Reels and Shorts
Five in one go stay open.
The next one sends you to that app’s Home.
Instagram goes to Instagram Home. YouTube goes to YouTube Home.
Leave the reel screen and the count starts over.
A reel a friend sent in a chat still plays. Swipe past five and you go to Instagram Home.

Android phones only. This does not run on an iPhone.

Android shows a warning that this access could see personal or financial info. Android shows that for every app that can see the screen. IG Gate has no internet access and does not read banks, passwords, or messages.

Turn it on once
1. Tap Allow access. Open IG Gate in that list and switch it on.
2. If Android blocks the switch: Settings, Apps, IG Gate, the corner menu, Allow restricted settings.

Share app sends IG-Gate.apk. The other phone must be Android. They install the file, then turn IG Gate on the same way.
Open Settings, then Accessibility, then turn on IG Gate.
IG Gate paused for a moment. Open Home or your messages yourself.
